candidate.name: Permission Coin
official_claims: Permission's current public site describes a family-friendly AI product and says ASK rewards positive behavior, including learning and healthy digital habits.
The official token documentation describes ASK as the Permission ecosystem's native token, with rewards and agent-to-agent coordination utility.
The token documentation states a fixed supply of 100,000,000,000 ASK.
The official token documentation lists Base and Polygon contract addresses and describes ASK as a LayerZero OFT live on Stargate.
The official site says ASK rewards can be redeemed for gift cards through its rewards partner Tremendous, subject to minimum redemption thresholds.
The reviewed official token page contains no matching text for XRP or XRPL; this is a page-level negative finding, not proof that no third-party bridge exists.

network_scope.XRP_Ledger_or_XRPL: No direct deployment or integration was found in the reviewed official token documentation.

candidate.identity_confidence: Strong candidate for the generic phrase because the official project uses the ASK ticker; not enough evidence to identify it as the user's intended ASK Coin.

current_third_party_market_snapshot.data_status: Third-party rendered page; no exact source cutoff or byte-complete raw receipt in this artifact.
current_third_party_market_snapshot.interpretation: The displayed 24-hour volume is extremely small relative to the displayed market capitalization. Treat it as a low-liquidity warning, not a reliable executable price or a valuation of the wider Permission platform.

disconfirming_evidence_and_limits: The user's phrase alone does not establish Permission Coin as the intended asset.
Official Permission documentation lists Base and Polygon, both EVM networks; it does not list XRPL or XRP.

The official site currently emphasizes family AI and reward redemption, while older market-data copy emphasizes the agentic web; preserve the product-positioning evolution rather than treating either description as a complete historical record.
No verified direct Ripple, SBI, Coinbase, Circle or XRPL relationship was found for this ASK candidate in the reviewed official sources.

candidate_occurrences.claim: A secondary article describes a $13.84M XRP short on Hyperliquid at 20x leverage and calls approximately $692,000 the implied actual capital.
limitations: The article attributes the position to a U.Today report, not a raw account receipt.
No full wallet/account state, cross-versus-isolated margin mode, other positions, collateral haircuts or account equity were independently verified.
$692,000 is a simplified notional/leverage calculation, not verified actual capital.

candidate_occurrences.claim: A separate secondary report describes a 14.189M XRP Hyperliquid long with $16.3M notional at 20x and a 52.67 BTC deposit reported at $3.26M.
limitations: The sources republish an Onchain Lens attribution; they are not independent account-state verification.
A gross BTC deposit is not proof that all deposited value became position margin.
The $815,000 value is an arithmetic estimate under a simplified 20x assumption, not verified account equity.

separate_meanings: Ripple Prime/Hidden Road regulatory net capital is a regulated firm-capital measure, not an XRP trader's initial margin.
Customer-segregated funds are not the firm's own capital.
Repo/reverse-repo financing balances are not the same as regulatory net capital or XRP position margin.
Position notional, gross deposits, implied initial margin and actual account equity must remain separate.
exact_phrase_findings.conclusion: The exact phrase appears in secondary XRP leveraged-position commentary, but no evidence links either Hyperliquid event to the user's original phrase. Preserve both as separate leads and keep Ripple Prime/Hidden Road regulatory capital as a distinct research track.

exact_phrase_findings.finding: The reviewed official SBIC East material describes an educational generative-AI/ChatGPT seminar for investee companies. That does not establish an OpenAI partnership. SBIC East/Central/West remain distinct from SBI Holdings; SBI Holdings' own ChatGPT Enterprise adoption is a separate corporate relationship.
exact_phrase_findings.limitation: The phrase may be shorthand or a transcription; no additional primary evidence establishes a formal SBIC-OpenAI agreement.
